provenance.existing: spec section 6.2 lists the six dimensions the product evaluation must cover. Use-case scores, parts cost and budget come from the existing balance model; the appearance score comes from design/finish-options.json.
provenance.new: The normalisation ranges and the direction of each dimension are original game balance.
provenance.limits: A reporting model that turns the existing numbers into six comparable 0-100 scores. It does not change how a machine is built or priced.

dimensions.note: 该机在目标用途上的适配分，直接取现有用途评分
与目标无关的绝对能力：三个用途得分之和除以参考值。用途单一但极强的机器与三项均衡的机器在这里会得到不同的分数；这个分数给玩家看，不直接进入客户决策——客户看的是目标用途分
通过热稳定得 60 分起步，再按供电余量加分；不稳定则最多 40 分；这个分数给玩家看，不直接进入客户决策——热稳定本身已经通过交付问题与返工影响结果
噪声负担越低分越高，参考值取满载风冷机型的负担量级
基础分加所选工艺档的外观分，见 design/finish-options.json
配件成本占预算的比例越低分越高，预算取该样机的 budgetCoins 上限

rules.everyDimensionScored: A machine must produce a score for all six dimensions or the evaluation is incomplete
rules.independentOfTarget: Performance and appearance never depend on the target use case; use-case fit does
rules.everyDimensionUsedOrDeclared: 每个维度要么被客户决策读取，要么显式标为 informational；不允许默默无人使用
